title: 时间转换
problem_statement_md:
你需要写一个程序来将天数转换为秒数。
给定的代码将天数作为输入。

请完成这段代码，将其转换为秒，并输出结果。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Time Converter[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need a program to convert days to seconds. 
The given code takes the amount of days as input. Complete the code to convert it to seconds and output the result.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
12

[b]Sample Output:[/b] 
1036800
[note]Explanation: 12 days are 12*[b]24[/b] = 288 hours, which are 288*[b]60[/b] = 17280 minutes, which are 17280*[b]60[/b] = [b]1036800[/b] seconds. [/note]
